breakdown.description: Gamma-centered k-point sampling conflicts with a half-shifted Monkhorst-Pack mesh.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification uses 'gamma-centered' Monkhorst-Pack grids throughout (8x8x8 for vc-relax/scf and 16x16x16 for nscf), with no mention of a half shift. This correctly resolves the contradiction between gamma-centered sampling and a half-shifted Monkhorst-Pack mesh, aligning with the ground truth which only specifies a gamma-centered k-point grid.
